name: deutsche-dichtkunst
description: Write, revise and analyze classical German poems with a structured check of meter, rhyme, cadence and syllables. Includes a Python syllable estimator and German reference material.

interface.longDescription: Write personal German poems for Christmas cards, Advent, birthdays, weddings and other occasions. Revise uneven lines or analyze meter, rhyme and cadence. Choose a secular, humorous or Christian tone to match the occasion. The skill uses a structured drafting and revision method plus German reference material. A bundled Python script estimates syllable counts when code execution is available. Otherwise the skill explains that its syllable check was manual. Stress and rhyme are assessed by the model; results can contain errors and should be read aloud before use.
defaultPrompt: Schreibe ein Weihnachtsgedicht für meine Eltern aus drei Erinnerungen.
Überarbeite meinen Weihnachtsgruß, damit er flüssiger klingt.
Schreibe ein christliches Adventsgedicht für unseren Gemeindebrief.
